name: H6 Private Store for WooCommerce
author: Jo Cox

sections.description:
Turn your WooCommerce store into a private, members-only area. Choose exactly what gets restricted and who can see it, with simple, reliable access control that works with any theme.

Restriction Modes

  • Whole site — Hide your entire website from logged-out users.
  • Whole store — Lock down all WooCommerce pages including Shop, Product pages, Cart, and Checkout.
  • Selected parts — Restrict only the items you choose: Pages, Posts, Products, Product Categories, Product Tags, Post Categories, and Post Tags.

Search Visibility Controls

Choose how search engines handle restricted content:
– Leave indexing behavior unchanged
– Send an X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow header on restricted requests
– Optionally add best-effort robots.txt rules to discourage crawling

Works with any theme

H6 Private Store for WooCommerce uses native WooCommerce login and your existing theme styles. No templates to override, no front-end redesign, and no theme-specific setup.

Simple setup

Just activate the plugin, choose what to restrict, and your store becomes private instantly.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/h6-private-store-for-woocommerce/.
  2. Activate via Plugins.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → H6 Private Store to configure.
sections.faq:
Does this block bots from indexing restricted content?

If enabled, we send an X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow header. You can also add robots.txt Disallow rules. Note: search engine behavior isn’t guaranteed.

Where do users log in?

We redirect to WooCommerce My Account, preserving the original destination via redirect_to.
